title: bankframe
summary: The bank follows current Benilla's law-owned 384x512 left-panel seat and single UI-BankFrame slab, live banker portrait/name, purse and purchase-cost coin cells, MainMenu cues, and law-positioned purchase confirmation. A fresh bank session now opens the existing backpack before the bank's own open cue, matching the reference lifecycle without changing MSUI's protected bag geometry or art. Its 24 generic slots use the exact authored (40,73) first seat with 49x44 anchor-chain pitch and share the inventory cursor law. The six live bank-bag buttons use the exact (40,274) first seat with 49-pixel pitch, address player slots 63..68, show their bag icons and checked state, accept carried bags, and toggle rule-stacked container windows 5..10 whose contents reuse the ordinary bag pickup/place/swap/split/lock/tooltip flow. The unreachable raw-ImGui fallback bank surface was removed; the production renderer contains no locally authored Vector2 geometry. Focused BankFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: The six bank-bag popout container windows (Benilla BenillaBankBagFrame1..6, container ids 5..10) do not exist - purchased bank bag slots show ring art only; bags placed there cannot be opened or used
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: bank container -1 is mapped by InventoryUiLaw to player-array slots 39..62. The rendered slots now use shared click, drag/drop, carried-item, pending-lock and law-positioned StackSplit behavior; right-click remains the distinct server-selected auto-withdraw action.

openItems.text: No drag-and-drop cursor flow for bank slots (click withdraws whole item by entry; no place-into-specific-slot, no stack split)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: player bank-bag slots 63..68 now feed six live buttons and rule-stacked popout windows for containers 5..10. Each window resolves its streamed container object, icon, name, capacity and contents and reuses ordinary bag cursor, split, lock, tooltip and close behavior.

openItems.text: No banker portrait/name title (Benilla binds SetPortraitTexture 'npc' and BANKFRAME_OPENED name)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: BankFrameUiLaw owns the current left-panel seat and portrait geometry; the renderer resolves the banker name and draws the live unit portrait behind the stock slab art.

openItems.text: No player money display on the window (Benilla BenillaBankFrameMoneyCoin1..3), and no purchase confirmation popup (CONFIRM_BUY_BANK_SLOT) - purchase fires immediately
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the player purse and next-slot price use denomination coin cells, and Purchase now opens a dedicated law-positioned confirmation before CMSG_BUY_BANK_SLOT is sent.

openItems.text: BANKFRAME_OPENED shows the bank but does not open the backpack first, unlike current Benilla's OpenBackpack lifecycle and sound ordering.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: A fresh bank session now opens only the existing backpack window before playing igMainMenuOpen. Repeated packets for the same session do not replay either transition, bank closure retains the ordinary backpack, and protected bag presentation remains unchanged. Focused BankFrame and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: The bank title used the shared gold NPC-title font instead of BankFrame's authored white GameFontHighlight, the Item Slots and Bag Slots labels were absent, and the purchase question/button bypassed their exact XML font and vertical seats.
openItems.resolution: BankFrameUiLaw now owns the unique title font, both section-label centers, the centered 280px GameFontHighlight purchase question wrap, and the cost-row-aligned half-pixel button seat. Bank renders all of them without changing protected backpack or container-window presentation. Focused BankFrame and full interface suites pass.

openItems.text: Bank bag-button tooltips followed the mouse instead of the explicit ANCHOR_RIGHT owner seat in BankFrame.
openItems.resolution: BankFrameUiLaw now owns the bank-bag tooltip anchor and bottom-left pivot. Equipped, empty purchased, and purchasable slot labels sit at the 37px button's top-right without changing protected backpack or bag-window presentation. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.
